title: World Surf Reserve

points: Noosa was declared a World Surf Reserve in 2020: the 10th in the world and the 3rd in Australia.
It runs from the point breaks of Laguna Bay at Noosa Main Beach to the beach break at North Sunshine Beach.
Noosa Main Beach is one of the few north facing beaches on Australia's east coast, so it's good for swimming and surfing all year.
It's home to the Noosa Festival of Surfing, one of the biggest surfing events in the world.

sources: Moved from Local facts for a chat (EO-TR-10, then EO-TR-14 Being a tour guide), 12/11/2026.
